verdict.rationale: A test or sandbox mode that lets users trial an action-taking agent without touching real accounts is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented sandbox, test mode, or dry-run environment. Muse's own VM, approve-before-acting cards, VM backups, and one-time payment cards are adjacent safety controls that still operate on the user's real linked data, so they earn no credit here.
